Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are out in the middle now. Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis are the two openers for Sri Lanka. Fazalhaq Farooqi to start with the new ball. Here we go...
WOW! Some good news coming our way. The rain has stopped and we can expect some action in a short while.

UPDATE - 6.37 pm IST (1.07 pm GMT) - There was a slight drizzle at the end of first innings and the covers are on. The start of the run chase has been delayed due to wet outfield, but it should not be a long wait. Stay tuned for more updates.
... The Run Chase ...

Right then. The onus now lies on the Sri Lanka batters to chase this target down and level the series. Although the pitch is slow and the hosts need to be very careful of the Afghan spin attack. We are in for an entertaining finish to the game. Do join us for the chase shortly.

A solid bowling performance from the host! Sri Lanka were put on the backfoot right at the start when they were unable to break the second-wicket stand. Then when the spinners put a lid over the scoring rate in the middle over the batters started to struggle. Dhananjaya de Silva and Maheesh Theekshana pounced on the opportunity and got rid of both the set batter in quick succession. Later, the bowlers continued to chip wickets at regular intervals. Kasun Rajitha bowled well in the death overs and stood out with the ball with three wickets.

Afghanistan batter picked things up right where they left from. Except Zadran who could not get anywhere closer to replicate his knock of the previous game and fell quite early. Although, Gurbaz and Shah took their to settle at the crease and stitched a crucial second-wicket stand of 113 runs. Both the batters made their respective half-centuries and with the way they were going ton wasn't impossible for both of them. But the pressure of the dot balls piled up and from being 135/1 at one stage Afghanistan were teetering at 149/4 in a jiffy. Later, only a single stand between Hashmatullah Shahidi and Mohammad Nabi that made a difference. If not for them even 200 could've been out of sights.

WOW! An incredible comeback from the hosts and undoubtedly, they are the happier side going into the break. At one stage, Afghanistan were looking pretty solid to reach near the 300-run mark, although the Sri Lankan bowlers have managed to bowl them out for 228.

OUT! TAKEN! Afghanistan have been bowled out here! Lahiru Kumara bowls the slower delievery, on a length and on off, Yamin Ahmadzai is early through his drive and ends up chipping it towards covers where Charith Asalanka takes a brilliant catch diving forward. So, the target for Sri Lanka will be 229 to level the series.
Commentary.Howout: c Charith Asalanka b Lahiru Kumara

Commentary.Commentary: Back of a length and on leg, angling in, Fazalhaq Farooqi makes room and slaps it down to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Fazalhaq Farooqi slashes hard at it and gets an outside edge towards third man for a single.
Short of a length and on off, Fazalhaq Farooqi sways away from it.
A slower one, full and on off, Fazalhaq Farooqi swings hard, but only connects with thin air.
Short of a length and on off, Yamin Ahmadzai guides it towards third man for a single.
Yamin Ahmadzai is the last man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Kasun Rajitha has the last laugh! Mohammad Nabi loses his wicket trying to go for another attacking shot. Kasun Rajitha takes pace of this delivery and serves this full, on off, Mohammad Nabi goes for the same shot, but this time his bat turns in his hands as he hits the ball and it goes flat and in the air towards long off where Dhananjaya de Silva runs to his to take a good sliding catch. Afghanistan nine down now.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! BOOM! Mohammad Nabi with a good hit! Kasun Rajitha serves this full and on off, in the slot as well, Mohammad Nabi stays there and smashes it through the line over the long off fence for a biggie.
This is full and outside off, way outside off, Mohammad Nabi fails to reach it as well. Wided.
Flighted and around off, Fazalhaq Farooqi moves back and defends it to the off side.
Flatter, full and on middle, Mohammad Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Mohammad Nabi goes for the big slog, but gets an inside edge towards short fine leg. Farooqi wants the single, but he is sent back.
Short again and on middle, Mohammad Nabi pushes it towards long on again.
Short and on middle, Mohammad Nabi slaps it down the ground towards long on, but denies the single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Mohammad Nabi works it with the outer half towards point.
Two dots to end the over! A sharp bumper, on middle Fazalhaq Farooqi ducks under it. Two wickets and just a single off it.
A dot now! A short ball, nipping in a touch from outside off. Fazalhaq Farooqi plays inside the line here.
Fazalhaq Farooqi comes in at number 10.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! Kasun Rajitha gets two in the over! He bowls this short again and on middle, Mujeeb Ur Rahman takes his eyes away from the ball and tries to pull it away, but gets a top edge towards the keeper where Kusal Mendis makes no mistake. This is turning out to be a great over for Sri Lanka.
Commentary.Howout: c Kusal Mendis b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Kasun Rajitha welcomes Mujeeb Ur Rahman with a bouncer on off, Mujeeb Ur Rahman sways away from it.
Mujeeb Ur Rahman is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Rashid Khan goes now! This will surely make a difference of a few runs in the total score. Sri Lanka with a huge wicket. Kasun Rajitha bowls the slower one, full and outside off, deceives the batter well. Rashid Khan fails to read it, and reaches for it, but he is too early into the shot and the ball takes the outer edge and flies up in the air towards long off where Dhananjaya de Silva takes a nice catch. Afghanistan lose their seventh.
Commentary.Howout: c Dhananjaya de Silva b Kasun Rajitha

Commentary.Commentary: Full and outside off, Mohammad Nabi thumps it towards long off for a single.
Floated and full, outside off. Nabi pushes it into covers and crosses.

Swing and a miss! It is pushed through quicker, on fifth stump. Nabi tries to go for the booming drive through the off side but gets beaten. The keeper gathers the ball and takes off the bails in a flash. The square leg umpire takes it upstairs. The replays later confirms that the back leg is grounded and the big screen shows NOT OUT.
Fuller, wide of off. Khan reaches out and drives it to sweeper cover for one.
A single now as this is knocked down to long on.

Overthrows and this is going to be costly for Sri Lanka. It is full, on the pads, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket and calls for two runs. The running is better but the throw from the deep is wayward. There is no backing and it races away to the boundary on the other side.
Short ball, on off. Khan goes back and knocks it down to long on for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana (9-1-39-2) to bowl out now.
An off-pace delivery this time, short and on off. Nabi pushes it to mid off.

FOUR! Mohammad Nabi finds the gap. Top shot. A short ball, on middle and leg, at 133 clicks. Mohammad Nabi swivels and pulls it in front of square on the leg side. The fielder in the deep puts in a valiant effort but in vain.
Rashid Khan gets off the mark! It is a short ball, sliding down leg. Khan flicks it to deep square leg for one.
WIDE! A sharp bouncer going down leg. Khan ducks under it. Wide called.
Mohammad Nabi stays back to this short delivery and pulls it to deep square leg just for a single.
A slower ball, on a length, outside off. Nabi throws hi bat at it mishits it to covers.
A length ball, attacking the pads, nipping in. Nabi flicks it to mid-wicket and the fielder there it quick to run to his right and collect the ball.
This one is skidding through, full and on middle. Rashid Khan gets his blade down in time to block it away.
Shorter and on leg, Khan blocks it back to the bowler.
Pushed through quicker and on off. Khan drives it back to Hasaranga.
It is a googly now, around off. Khan gets it back to the bowler off the inner half.
A single now as this is pushed to mid off.
Flatter and shorter, wide of off. Nabi hangs back and cuts it to deep point for a brace.
Back of a length, on middle. Nabi pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Rashid Khan is the next batter in for Afghanistan.

OUT! RUN OUT! Direct hit by Dhananjaya Lakshan does the trick for Sri Lanka. Hashmatullah Shahidi has to depart now. It is a length ball, on off. Shahidi pushes it to extra cover with soft hands and calls for a quick single. Dhananjaya Lakshan gathers the ball and scores a direct-hit at the non-striker's end. Hashmatullah Shahidi puts in a dive but his bat stays in the air after crossing the line. Sri Lanka making inroads in this game.
Kasun Rajitha bends his back hard and serves a short ball, outside off, it flies off the deck. Hashmatullah Shahidi stays behind and tries to play the ramp shot but misses.
Kasun Rajitha dishes a full one now, on leg. Hashmatullah Shahidi clips it through mid-wicket and collects a brace.
On a good length, on off, Nabi shuffles and tucks it behind square on the leg side for a single.
Back of a length, on middle and leg. Nabi flicks it towards square leg.
Kasun Rajitha (5-2-10-0) is back on.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it through the gap at covers. The batters take a couple before the fielder cuts it out.
A single now as this is worked down to long on.
Flatter and outside off, pushed towards covers.
On off, defended out.

It is full, sliding down leg. Mohammad Nabi gets pinged on his pads as he fails to flick it. There is a stifled appeal and the umpire shows no interest. Dasun Shanaka thinks that the ball straightens a bit and takes the review. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracking confirms that it is umpire's call on ball hitting the wickets. Sri Lanka do not lose a review here but Nabi still remains at the crease.
A googly now, turning away from the left-hander. Shahidi plays it late and guides it to backward point for one.
Angles this one on the pads, Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it through square leg for a single.
Fires this one down the leg side, Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his flick. Wided.
Darts in a yorker, on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi digs it back to the bowler.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi reverse-sweeps it but straight to covers.
Short and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it towards point.
Pushed through quicker, on middle and leg, Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There is a slight appeal for LBW, but the finger stays down.
Flatter delivery, on off, angling in sharply, Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it to the off side.
Quicker delivery, on off, Mohammad Nabi miscues his cut and bunts it onto the ground.
Short and outside off, Mohammad Nabi plays it towards covers.
SIX! BANG! Mohammad Nabi goes big! This is flighted, full and on middle, Mohammad Nabi stays there and smoeks it over the long on fence for a biggie.
Tossed up, full and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi works it towards long on for a run.
Flatter and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi decides to uses his feet, but guides it from his crease towards point at the end.
Wanindu Hasaranga with another googly, short and on off, turning in, Mohammad Nabi reads it and forces it down to long on for a single.
Full and on off, Mohammad Nabi pushes it through cover-point for a single.
Lahiru Kumara loses his line and bowls this down the leg side, Mohammad Nabi misses his flick. Wided.
Goes a touch fuller, on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi works it through square leg for a single.
This is on a good length and around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi closes the face of his bat and defends it to the leg side.
Short and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi reaches for it and slaps it wide of sweeper cover for a brace.
On a length and on off, Mohammad Nabi slices it through backward point for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! Lahiru Kumara serves this full and on the pads, Mohammad Nabi stays there and clips it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Short again and on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi knocks it towards mid-wicket.
Short and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it through covers for a brace.
On off, kept out.
This is almost on a yokrer length, on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi swats it on the ground as the bounces takes it over the bowler, but short-mid-wicket gathers it.
Oh..close! A googly again, on middle, skidding through, Mohammad Nabi gets hurried but manages to push it through cover for a single and gets off the mark.
Mohammad Nabi is the new batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Wanindu Hasaranga strikes straightaway after coming back into the attack. He bowls this googly this time, on middle, turning in a bit, Gulbadin Naib goes for the slog-sweep, but is through his shot early and misses the ball completely. as it goes through and rattle the stumps. A poor shot from Naib and he throws his wicket away. Afghanistan five down now.
Angles this one into the batter, on leg, Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it to the leg side. Dhananjaya de Silva finishes his spell with figures of 10-0-37-1.
Darts this one full, on middle, Gulbadin Naib drives it towards long on for a single.
Dhananjaya de Silva continues with the shorter length, outsdie off this time, Gulbadin Naib makes room and forces it wide of long off for a couple of runs.
Looped up, full and on middle, Gulbadin Naib knocks it towards short mid-wicket.
Short again and on the pads, Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it around the corner on the leg side for a run.
Short and on middle, Gulbadin Naib works it through square leg for a single.
On middle, blocked out.
Floated, full and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi drills it wide of long off for a brace.
FOUR! A much-needed boundary for Afghanistan. A carrom delivery, much quicker, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi plays the reverse-sweep and gets it through the gap at backward point for a boundary.
TURN AND BOUNCE! Maheesh Theekshana bowls this slower through the air, on off, turing away sharply with extra bounce, Hashmatullah Shahidi sways his bat away from it.
Tossed up, full and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi blocks it out.
FLatter delivery, on off, Gulbadin Naib looks to play at it but misses and the keeper cannot gather it as well. A bye is taken.
Shorter again and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi makes room for the cut but decides to defend it at the end.
Quicker again, bit short and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi bunts it onto the ground to the off side.
Short and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it but straight to point.
On off, kept out.
Looped up, on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi uses his feet but only manages to knock it with the inner half towards the bowler.
Quicker one, full and on middle, Gulbadin Naib drives it towards long on for a single.
Short and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up and around off, Gulbadin Naib uses his feet and works it towards long off for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana gives this one some air, on middle, Gulbadin Naib fends it down the pitch.
On middle, blocked out.
Short and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi goes on his back foot and cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi defends it on the front foot.
Slower through the air, on middle, turning in, Gulbadin Naib watches it through and blocks it out.
Shorter in length and outside off, Hashmatullah Shahidi cuts it through point for a run.
Darts this one down the leg, Hashmatullah Shahidi misses his flick and gets hit on the pads.
Three dots in a row! This is flighted and around off, Hashmatullah Shahidi plays it on the off side.
Looped up, full and on off, Hashmatullah Shahidi pushes it towards extra cover.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Hashmatullah Shahidi knocks it back to the bowler.
A maiden-wicket over! This is darted on a yorker length, on off, Gulbadin Naib digs it out towards covers.
Shortish and on off, Gulbadin Naib goes back and punches it towards extra cover.
Flatter delivery, on middle, holds its line, Gulbadin Naib looks to flick it but gets a leading edge towards covers.
A full toss, on middle, Gulbadin Naib strokes it straight back to the bowler.
Gulbadin Naib is the new man in.

OUT! LBW! Afghanistan are losing their way here! Maheesh Theekshana gets his second wicket. He bowls this flatter and quicker around middle, Najibullah Zadran goes down and tries to paddle it away, but misses and gets hit on the hips. There is a huge appeal for LBW, but turned down. Dasun Shanaka goes for the review straightaway. The UltraEdge shows no bat involved and Ball Tracking indicates three reds. Zadran has to walk back, and the Lankans are delighted.
A bit short and on middle, Najibullah Zadran looks to play at it but gets an inside edge to the leg side.
Looped up, on off. Hashmatullah Shahidi presses forward and blocks it into the deck.
Tosses it up, outside off. Zadran looks to go for the paddle, but it takes the outside edge and goes to short third man. They take one.
Hashmatullah Shahidi now drives this full delivery to sweeper cover for one.
DDS continues to come around the wicket. Fuller and on leg. Zadran clips it towards short fine and takes a single.
On middle, Zadran blocks it on his front foot.
Fuller, coming in with the arm. Shahidi sweeps it to mid-wicket and scampers across for a quick single.
Goes very full, outside off. Zadran opens the face late and guides it to backward point. Hashmatullah Shahidi denies the single this time. A successful over by Maheesh Theekshana comes to an end.
FOUR! Short and punished! Najibullah Zadran gets off the mark in fine fashion. It is short, outside off. Najibullah Zadran stays back and smashes it through covers for four.
Full and on off. Zadran flicks it to mid-wicket. Dasun Shanaka there dives to his left and makes a solid stop.
Najibullah Zadran walks out to bat now.

OUT! LBW! This looks plumb and the umpire agrees as well. Rahmat Shah though decides to take the review. Maheesh Theekshana tosses it up, full and on middle, turning into the batter a bit. Rahmat Shah gets down on one knee and tries to slog it away. He is though a touch early into his shot and the ball sneaks under his blade to ping him on the pads. Maheesh Theekshana appeals and the finger goes up. The UltraEdge confirms that no bat is involved. Later, the Ball Tracking confirms that it is umpire's call on ball hitting the wickets. Hence, Sri Lanka get their third wicket but this time Afghanistan do not lose a review.
Full and on leg. Shah blocks it back to the bowler.
Flatter and quicker, on leg, Shah clips it to the leg side.
FOUR! Exceptional shot. It is tossed up, full and on middle. Hashmatullah Shahidi gets down on one knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. He is making his intent clear here.
Slower and shorter, on off. Shah goes back, nudges it to mid-wicket and crosses.
Loops it up, outside off. Hashmatullah Shahidi drives it down to long off for a single. He gets off the mark instantly.
Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan comes out to the middle now.

OUT! CAUGHT! Rahmanullah Gurbaz is very upset with himself. He trudges back to the pavilion. Dhananjaya de Silva breaks this huge partnership. The crowd has something to cheer now as well. It is full and on off. Gurbaz dances down the track with an hope to break the shackles. He though miscues his shot and it goes straight into the hands of Maheesh Theekshana at long off. Will Sri Lanka be able to crawl back into the game?
Commentary.Howout: c Maheesh Theekshana b Dhananjaya de Silva

Commentary.Commentary: Good running! It is full, attacking the pads, Gurbaz clips it to deep square leg for quick two runs.
Loops it up, slower through the air, around middle. Gurbaz flicks it to the leg side.

Goes full, on off. Gurbaz drives it back to the bowler. Maheesh Theekshana gets low quickly and makes a sharp stop. He though has a shy at the non-striker's end which ends in an overthrown. The batters sneak a single.
Yet again sliding down leg. Gurbaz clips it to short mid-wicket once again.
Loops it up, on middle and leg. Gurbaz works it to short mid-wicket.
It is full, on leg stump. Shah knocks it down to long on for a single.
Pushed through, on leg. Shah is not left with much room to put it away.
Maheesh Theekshana goes slower now and follows the batter down leg. Shah blocks it out.
Slight Halt! Rahmanullah Gurbaz is feeling some cramps in his legs, and the physio is in to check on him. He looks fine and we are ready to continue.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Shah comes down the track and knocks it towards long on for an easy single.
On off, blocked out.
Looped up, full and on middle. Shah flicks it to the right of short mid-wicket. Wanindu Hasaranga does well to restrict a single here.
Yet again attacking the leg stump. Gurbaz clips it square on the leg side for another single.
It is tossed up, on middle and leg. Shah nurdles it to the leg side for one.
It is very full, Shah gets low and sweeps it from outside off towards deep mid-wicket for two runs.
Rahmat Shah works this full delivery towards sweeper cover. They cross for one. Shah will retain the strike. A positive over for Afghanistan.
This is going down leg. Gurbaz hangs back and flicks it to deep square leg for just a single.

SIX! Rahmanullah Gurbaz is turning on the heat here. Its been a while since the last boundary. It is tossed up, full and on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets low and slogs it over mid-wicket for a maximum. The stand moves to 102. This partnership has started to take the game away from the hosts.
Fuller, on off. Shah plays it down to long and gets to the other side.
Rahmanullah Gurbaz now rotates the strike as he flicks it through square leg.
Rahmat Shah gets the single and records his 22nd half-century in ODIs. It is full, down leg. Shah flicks it around the corner and crosses. He gets a standing ovation from the dressing room.
Maheesh Theekshana comes back into the attack. He has conceded 12 runs in his two overs.
It is full and on off. Gurbaz blocks it on his front foot. Just a single off it.
Loops it up, outside off, Gurbaz strokes it to mid off.
Much quicker, full and on leg. Gurbaz goes back and plays it back to the bowler again.
On off, driven back to the bowler.
Pushed through quicker, on off, Shah eases it to long on for one.
Pitched up, outside off, driven into covers.
Full, on leg, Gurbaz clips it to the leg side.
Goes short and outside off, sticks to the surface and keeps low, Rahmanullah Gurbaz miscues his shot towards short extra cover.
Floated, full and on middle, Rahmat Shah gets to the pitch of it and drives it down to long on for a single.
Tossed up, full and o middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes down and sweeps it through square leg for a single.
A bit short and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz moves back and knocks it back to the bowler.
Quicker delivery, on middle and leg, angling in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets hurried a bit as the ball hits his back pad.
This is full and driven into covers.
Tossed up, on off, Shah gets it to the leg side.
On off, pushed to mid off.
Quicker, on middle and leg. Gurbaz works it to long on for a single.
Loops it up, on off, blocks it out.
On off, blocked out.
Full and on off. Shah dances down the track and drives it down the ground. Wanindu Hasaranga kills the pace off it by his legs. So three dots on the trot to end the over.
Much shorter, outside off. Shah punches it through covers.
A dot now as Shah blocks it out to the off side.
Touch short, on the pads, Gurbaz flicks it past mid on and crosses for a single.
Tosses it up, around off. Gurbaz blocks it to point off the outer half.
A googly on off. Shah goes back and knocks it down to long on for one.

SIX! FIFTY FOR GURBAZ! He has continued his form from the first game, but he will try to convert this into a big score now. This is flighted and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz comes down the track and smashes it over the long off fence for a biggie.
Quicker one, full and on leg, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Shorter in length and outside off, Rahmat Shah cuts it towards deep point for a single.
Floated, full and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz eases it towards long on for another run.
Tossed up, full and on off, Rahmat Shah works it towards long off for a run.
Slower through the air, short and on off, Rahmat Shah knocks it towards short mid-wicket.

Lahiru Kumara lands this short and on middle, Rahmat Shah hooks it towards deep square leg where the fielder makes a brilliant stop diving to his right. A single is taken and that brings up the 100 for Afghanistan.
Fuller again and on off, Rahmat Shah mistimes his drive towards mid on.

Lahiru Kumara bowls this full and on middle and leg, angling in, Rahmat Shah misses his flick and gets hit on the pads. There is a stiffled appealf for LBW, but turned down. It was going down the leg side anyways.
Back of a length and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes back and punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Good length, on the pads, Shah flicks it to fine leg for a single.
This is full and on off, Rahmat Shah knocks it towards mid off.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz strokes it towards the bowler where Wanindu Hasaranga stops it.
Flatter, full and on middle, Rahmat Shah eases it towards long on for a single.

In the air....safe! Dhananjaya de Silva gives this some air, on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz skips down the track and tries to go for the big shot, but gets a top edge as the ball goes high in the air. Wanindu Hasaranga from mid on calls for it, but he fails to get there and it falls safely. A single is taken and Gurbaz gets a life.
Three dots in a row! This is floated and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz is again solid in his defense.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it back to the bowler.
Dhananjaya de Silva starts with a flighted delivery, full and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans on and blocks it out.
Short of a length and on middle, angling in, Rahmat Shah defends it down the pitch.
Good bowling! This is back of a length and on off, straightens a bit after hitting the deck, Rahmat Shah looks to play at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Back of a length and on off, Rahmat Shah pushes it towards covers.

FOUR! A lucky boundary for Shah, and it is the second time he survives like this! Lahiru Kumara serves this a bit fuller and on off, Rahmat Shah goes for the drive, but gets an inside edge past the stumps and towards the fine leg fence for four runs.
On a length and middle, Rahmat Shah blocsk it out.

Overthrows! Lahiru Kumara bowls this on a good length and on off, Rahmat Shah plays it towards point. The fielder there has a shy at the bowler's end and it deflects off the stumps towards long off. The batters get two runs.

DRINKS! It has been a good start by Afghanistan. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Rahmat Shah seem to have their eye-in and both are nearing their half-centuries. Sri Lanka know that they need to break this stand if they are to crawl back into this game. The pitch is slow and the spinners might hope to feast on it. Will the Sri Lankan spinners find a way to dismantle the Afghanistan batting order?

Risky single! This is on a length and on off, Rahmat Shah dabs it towards point and sets off for the run and Gurbaz responds as well. The fielder has a shy at the batter's end, but misses. It would have been close if it was a direct hit.
Short of a length and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! Dhananjaya Lakshan tries the slower one but bowls this a touch fuller, on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz reads it well and stays there to loft it over mid off for a boundary.
Dhananjaya Lakshan lands this short and on middle, Rahmat Shah pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Full again and on middle, Rahmat Shah knocks it towards mid on.

This is full and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it firmly towards sweeper cover where Maheesh Theekshana puts in an excellent dive to his left to stop it from going to the boundary. Three runs added to the total.
Wanindu Hasaranga ends the over with a googly, short and on middle, turning in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz punches it towards long on for a run.
Flighted delivery, full again and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz is solid in his defense.
Floated, full and on middle, Rahmat Shah drives it down to long on for a single.
Quciker one, on off, Rahmat Shah moves back and pushes it towards point.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Shah! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls the googly, on middle, turning in, Rahmat Shah uses his feet again and smashes it with the turn over mid on for four more runs.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Shah uses his feet well here! This is tossed up and around middle, Rahmat Shah skips down the track and lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Full again and on middle, Rahmat Shah strokes it wide of mid on where the fielder dives to his right to stop it. Only a single taken.
This is pitched up, on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it towards long on for a run.
On a length and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz covers the line and blocks it out.
Dhananjaya Lakshan serves this full and on middle, angling in, Rahmanullah Gurbaz does well to get some bat on it and works it towards short fine leg.
Back of a length and outside off, Rahmat Shah guides it towards third man for a run.
Full and on middle and leg, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
A googly, on off, turning in a bit, Rahmat Shah keeps it out.
Pushed through quicker, full and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it towards long off for a single.
FOUR! That is a pressure releasing shot! This is flighted, full and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes down and slog-sweeps it wide of deep mid-wicket for a boundary.

Oh..that is close! Wanindu Hasaranga bowls this quicker, short and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz goes for the cut from close to his body, but gets an inside edge which just misses the stumps. He is getting frustrated here.
Floated, full and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drills it back to the bowler.
BEATEN! This is tossed up, on off, turning a bit away, Rahmanullah Gurbaz tries to poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Goes a bit fuller and on off, Rahmat Shah opnes the face of his bat and guides it wide of third man where Kasun Rajitha covers his ground well and dives to his left to stop it. Two runs taken!
This is back of a length and outside off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz punches it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Brilliant fielding! Dhananjaya Lakshan serves this full and on middle, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it firmly down the pitch as Lakshan dives and stops it with his outstretched right hand.
On a length and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it to the off side.
EDGED AND FOUR! This is on a good length and around off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz leans on to block it, but gets a thick outisde edge towards the third man fence for a boundary.
Dhananjaya Lakshan begins with a full delivery but well outisde off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz has no intention to play at it.
A googly now, short and on off, Rahmat Shah guides it off the back foot towards point.
Flatter, full and on leg, Rahmat Shah eases it towards long on for a run.
Flighted delivery, full and on off, Rahmat Shah leans on and strokes it towards covers.
A bit short and around middle again, Rahmat Shah moves back and pushes it to the right of the bowler as Wanindu Hasaranga collects it.
Floated, full and on middle, Rahmat Shah knocks it back towards the bowler.
Wanindu Hasaranga starts with a tossed up delivery, full and on off, Rahmanullah Gurbaz drives it through extra cover for a single.
Powerplay 2! The fielding side can now have up to 4 players outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Also, Wanindu Hasaranga now comes into the attack for Sri Lanka.
So, 9 runs come off the over! Fuller, wide of off. Shah drives it to covers but straight to the fielder.
FOUR! This time Shah finds the gap really well. It is a short ball, on middle and leg. Shah pulls it through square leg for a boundary. 52 is up for Afghanistan with this boundary.
Fraction short, around off. Shah gets it back to the bowler off the bottom half.
Hard length, on off stump. Shah blocks it into covers.
FOUR! Rahmat Shah gets lucky once again. It is much full, on a length, on off. Rahmat Shah is stuck in his crease. The ball takes the inside edge, beats the stumps and races into the fine leg fence.
Rahmanullah Gurbaz flicks it off his hips towards square leg. They cross for one.
Yes, he certainly can. It is a length ball, outside off. Shah shuffles and blocks it to the off side.
Kasun Rajitha dishes 5 dots on the trot! A good bouncer this time, on middle. Shah sways away from the line of the delivery. Can he record his second maiden?
It is full, on off stump. Shah drives it out to safety.
Make it three! Much fuller, sliding down leg. Shah looks to flick it away but misses. He takes a blow on his pads.
Two dots on the trot! A slower ball, wide of off. Shah lets it be.
Kasun Rajitha continues to ask the right questions. It is an inswinging delivery, nice and full, on leg. Rahmat Shah blocks it out watchfully.

SIX! Massive hit! Rahmanullah Gurbaz couldn't have hit it any cleaner. It is pitched up, on off. Gurbaz gets behind the line and tonks it over the bowler's head for a maximum. 12 runs off the over. Sri Lanka have some thinking to do here.
A single now as Rahmat Shah guides this short ball towards short third man.
Much fuller, wide outside off. Shah reaches out and drives it to point. Not in the gap though.
Fraction short, on off, Shah defends it.
FOUR! Nicely played. Easy pickings for Shah. A low full toss, on leg stump. Rahmat Shah just closes the face and flicks it past mid on. The outfield is lightning fast and it races away to the fence.
A short ball, on the body. Gurbaz uses the depth of the crease, swivels and pulls it down to fine leg for a single.

Incredible over! Four dots in a row to end the over. It is a length ball, outside off. Shah looks to drive it away but misses and gets beaten on the outside edge. Kasun Rajitha has his hands on his head. He cannot believe it.
This is good bowling! Full length, on off. Shah closes the face and defends it to mid-wicket.
Outside off, left alone by Shah this time.
Full, on middle and leg. Shah nudges it to the leg side.

FOUR! EDGY! Rahmat Shah has some ladyluck on his side here. It is a full-length ball, around off. Shah strides forward and looks to drive it away through covers. The ball takes a thick outside edge and sneaks through the gap between wicket-keeper and first slip for four.
Rajitha starts his fourth over with a full ball, on off stump. Shah blocks it to covers.
Good-length ball, outside off. Gurbaz punches it through cover-point on his back foot. The batters take two runs. A wicket-taking over by Kumara comes to an end.
Two dots in a row! A length ball, on fifth stump. Gurbaz hits it on the up but the fielder at covers dives to his right to make a great stop.
Full-length ball, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz defends it out solidly.
Rahmat Shah is off the mark instantly. This is too straight on the pads. Shah stays back and flicks it to deep square leg. The batters take three. This is really good running.
Rahmat Shah walks out to bat at number 3.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Lahiru Kumara has the last laugh here. Lahiru Kumara bends his back hard this time and draws the first blood. Back of a length, outside off, getting some extra bounce off the deck with some inward movement. Ibrahim Zadran tries to dab it down to third man but unfortunately only finds a thick inside edge which goes onto shatter the stumps. Ibrahim Zadran is walking back and the Sri Lankan camp is elated.

FOUR! Classic shot! Lahiru Kumara is welcomed into the attack with a boundary, also a good-looking one. It is full, on off. Zadran stands still and drives it through the line. It beats the bowler and races away to the long off fence.
Lahiru Kumara comes into the attack now.
On a length, on fourth stump. Zadran gets a thick inside edge. The ball rolls past the stumps and goes towards fine leg. One taken. Sri Lankan bowlers are finding it difficult to get the ball moving.
In-swinger now, on off, much fuller. Zadran defends it out.
On middle and leg, blocked out.
FOUR! Incredible shot. It is much fuller, on off. Zadran shuffles and flicks it through the gap at mid on. The ball races away to the fence.

A stifled appeal for lbw! It is a length ball, pitching outside off and jagging back in. Zadran gets pinged on his thigh pads. The fielders behind the batter were more interested than the bowler here.
On off, blocked out.
Quicker and full, on leg. Gurbaz blocks it to short mid-wicket. A good over for Afghanistan, 8 runs come off it.
Ibrahim Zadran finally gets off the mark. It is tossed up, on middle and leg. Zadran works it to long on for a single this time.
Fuller, on middle and leg. Gurbaz eases it to long on for a single.
Pushed through quicker on a shorter length, Gurbaz tucks it to the leg side.
Fuller, on off, skidding on. Gurbaz gets it to the off side off the outer half.
SIX! Rahmanullah Gurbaz though continues on his merry way. It is tossed up, outside off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz slogs it over the mid-wicket fence for a maximum.
A maiden over by Kasun Rajitha. It is full and on off. Zadran offers full face of the bat to deal with the same. An exceptional over comes to an end.
Make that 5! Ibrahim Zadran is yet to get of the mark. Much fuller, attacking the stumps. Zadran strokes it towards mid off.
Fuller, angling down leg. Zadran hangs back and nudges it to mid-wicket. Four dots on the trot as well.
Good length, outside off. Zadran blocks it out solidly.
An in-swinging delivery, full and on middle. Zadran plays the on-drive this time. It is hit with perfection, although the fielder at mid on rushes to his left and makes a sharp stop.
Kasun Rajitha drags his length back, outside off, shaping further away. Zadran has no shot to offer here.
Slower through the air, full and on off. Gurbaz eases it back to the bowler. A tidy start for Maheesh Theekshana.
On midddle, clipped to mid-wicket.
FOUR! Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets the first boundary of the innings. It is tossed up, on off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz gets under it and lofts it over mid off. The ball has enough legs to reach the fence.
Loops it up, on off. Gurbaz blocks it back to Maheesh Theekshana on the front foot.
Much fuller, on off. Gurbaz gets it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Pushed through around off, turning in. Gurbaz blocks it back to the bowler.
We will see some spin now as Maheesh Theekshana is ready to share the attack.
On a length, around off. Zadran blocks it out watchfully. A soild start by Kasun Rajitha with the new ball.
Length, on off, pushed to covers.

Kasun Rajitha appeals and the umpire raises his finger in a flash. Ibrahim Zadran has a word with his partner and takes the review for lbw. Coming to the delivery, it is a full one, coming in from outside off. Zadran tries to block it out but gets beaten on the inside edge. The ball goes onto struck him on his pads. Sri Lanka started celebrating as the umpire agrees. Although, it has to be cut short as the review confirms that there is a spike as the ball passes the blade. Thanks to the technology, Zadran remains at the crease.
Goes much fuller this time, on middle and leg. Rahmanullah Gurbaz stays back and nudges it towards mid-wicket. Afghanistan and Rahmanullah Gurbaz are off the mark with a single here.
Kasun Rajitha goes short yet again, but this time wide of off. Rahmanullah Gurbaz covers his stumps and shoulders his arms at it.
Fraction short to start with. Angling into the batter. Gurbaz stays back and flicks it to square leg.

Well, the sun is shining in all its glory. Hopefully, the rain forecast turns out to be wrong and we get an uninterrupted match. The umpires are making their way out. Sri Lanka players are seen to be in a huddle before they spread out to their fielding position. Rahmanullah Gurbaz and Ibrahim Zadran are already at the crease and ready to get going. Kasun Rajitha to start proceedings with the ball. Let's play...

Dasun Shanaka, the captain of Sri Lanka says they would've loved to bat first as well. Informs they are still in the same phase and they need to execute their plans. Mentions that even they stick with their same squad.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the skipper of Afghanistan is in for a chat. He says that they will bat first. Adds the pitch is same and that's why they want to bat first. Mentions they are going with the same side. Adds they had a lot of positive to take back.

Pitch report - Tino Mawoyo is near the deck. There is a bit of a breeze blowing across the stadium. Mawoyo says that it is the same pitch that was used in the first game. The batting conditions are really good but during the second innings Sri Lanka need to be aware of the furious ball movement.

Sri Lanka (Unchanged playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Dinesh Chandimal, Dhananjaya de Silva, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka (C), Wanindu Hasaranga, Dhananjaya Lakshan, Maheesh Theekshana, Lahiru Kumara and Kasun Rajitha.

Afghanistan (Unchanged playing XI) - Ibrahim Zadran, Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hashmatullah Shahidi (C), Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Rahmat Shah, Gulbadin Naib, Rashid Khan, Mujeeb Ur Rahman, Fazalhaq Farooqi and Yamin Ahmadzai.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Afghanistan. They will BAT first.

Afghanistan are a team on the rise, and they showcased their all-round abilities to get the victory in the first game. Ibrahim Zadran scored a brilliant hundred, while Farooqi bagged a four-fer. They were undoubtedly the better side and deserved to get the win. Afghanistan will be looking to continue where they left off and try to seal the series with a game to spare. Will they be able to do it? Or will the Lankans bounce back? We will find out soon. Toss and team news in a bit.

Sri Lanka have been struggling a bit with their batting for a while now, and it showed in the first game as well. Sri Lanka do have a decent bowling attack, but they need to fire as a unit. They have to buckle up and produce the goods in this match to level the series, or else they will suffer an embarrassing series defeat.

Hello and a warm welcome, folks! We are here for the second ODI between two Asian rivals, Afghanistan and Sri Lanka. This is a fixture that has seen some exciting games in recent times, with both teams giving equal fight to each other, and we can expect nothing less than that. Let's see who comes out on top.
